Shipped: landed to master at 39afe4ec (final content matches reviewed commit 952e92e5 exactly -- confirmed empty diff on the affected files).

Delivers scoped dispatch-time testing infrastructure: explicit Slow/OptIn test classification, TestClassificationGuardTests, nightly Windmill scripts (nightly-coverage.ps1, nightly-tests-impl.ps1, nightly-health.ps1, nightly-common.ps1, c487-harness.ps1) with real coverage-completeness verdict logic against genuine pinned TUnit 1.44/MTP 2.2.2 diagnostics (not synthetic fixtures). docs/testing-and-build.md updated to record that the AGENTS.md-referenced Windmill nightly job (u/lndcobra/antiphon_nightly_tests) does not actually exist yet in Windmill -- a real, previously-undocumented gap, now tracked.

Across 8 review rounds tonight, confirmed real bugs found and fixed: zero-TRX false-complete, partial-suite/missing-discovery false-complete, NotExecuted/unknown-outcome granting completeness, missing production discovery producer, duplicate notification enqueue, real MTP/TUnit diagnostic-format parsing (was only tested against synthetic JSON), discovery-UID-vs-terminal-diagnostic-UID reconciliation (was wrongly comparing against TRX GUIDs), chunk-union coverage validation (was flagging cross-chunk classes as mutually missing), and finally the native nightly execution argv defect (--report-trx-filename receiving a full path caused the real pinned runner to exit 5 with no TRX at all -- meaning the production nightly job would never have produced results).

IMPORTANT LANDING INCIDENT during this card's own final land (see CARD-0495, Critical/Now): `delegate.ps1 -Land 1b4de7e3 -ExpectedSourceSha 952e92e5...` -- despite explicitly supplying the correct, freshly-verified reviewed SHA -- silently landed an OLDER commit (0ad78c8f) missing the last four commits including the entire argv fix that was the whole point of this dispatch. Caught by a direct post-land content spot-check (not by trusting the land notification), manually corrected by cherry-picking the four missing commits (361e8486, e8385c2f, a5e26766, 952e92e5) cleanly onto the already-landed master and re-pushing (f1b930a9..39afe4ec). This is a live recurrence of the exact class of bug CARD-0488 was supposed to have fixed -- CARD-0495 investigates why the -ExpectedSourceSha guard did not prevent it.

Follow-up work not yet carded, worth raising separately: the remaining CARD-0487 investigation items (physically separating slow tests into their own project vs. category-based filtering, TestDesign explicitly declaring in-scope/out-of-scope regression coverage per change) were partially addressed by the classification/nightly infrastructure shipped here but not the full original scope -- if further scoping-down of per-dispatch test execution is still wanted, that is fresh follow-up work, not covered by tonight's fixes.
